text:
morgan_support: Hey team — customer seeing 500s and failing message renders in the Console on the UI. Asked them to grab network + console logs but they need step-by-step. Can we post a copy-paste-ready set of repro capture instructions (HAR + console + curl) and what metadata to include?

sam_devx: Yep, here's a compact checklist you can paste to the customer. Keep it short.

sam_devx: 1) Reproduce the issue in a fresh browser window (Incognito/private). Note exact time you reproduce (UTC).

sam_devx: 2) Chrome/Edge steps (best):
- Open DevTools: F12 or Cmd+Option+I (Mac) / Ctrl+Shift+I (Windows).
- Go to the Network tab. Check: "Preserve log" and "Disable cache".
- Click the red record button if not recording. Reproduce the error in the UI.
- Right-click any request -> "Save all as HAR with content" and save as: har_1778001234.har (replace with the timestamp).

sam_devx: 3) Firefox:
- F12 -> Network tab -> click the gear -> enable "Persist Logs". Reproduce -> Gear menu -> "Save all as HAR".

sam_devx: 4) Console logs:
- Still in DevTools, go to Console. Right-click -> "Save as..." or select all and copy/paste into a .txt named console_1778001234.txt. Include the errors and stack traces.

sam_devx: 5) Important headers + request id:
- In the Network tab, click the failing request and open the "Headers" panel. Look for response headers: "X-Request-Id" or "Request-Id" (sometimes labeled "redwood-request-id"). Copy the full value and paste it in your reply.

sam_devx: 6) Provide a curl repro (if possible):
- Right-click the failing network request -> "Copy" -> "Copy as cURL".
- Paste the generated curl into your reply but redact your API key. Replace the token value with "REDACTED" (we only need the headers + body shape). Example template:
```
curl 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary '{"input":"hello"}' --compressed -v
```
- If you run the curl locally please run with `-v` and paste the response headers (again, redact secrets).

sam_devx: 7) If exporting HAR is blocked by extension/corp policy:
- Use "Copy as cURL" for the failing request and take a short screen recording (or screenshots) of DevTools showing the request/response and the console error.

sam_devx: 8) File naming and how to share:
- Attach files as: har_1778001234.har, console_1778001234.txt, curl_1778001234.txt.
- Upload to the support ticket or paste into this thread (attach as files, do NOT paste HAR content inline).

sam_devx: 9) Metadata to include (very helpful):
- Exact UTC timestamp of reproduction.
- Browser + version (chrome 114.0.5735.198), OS (macOS 13.4), network type (corporate / home wifi).
- Whether they were logged in and user id (last 4 chars is fine).

sam_devx: Quick reminder: DO NOT paste API keys or full tokens in Slack. Mask them as REDACTED or XXXXXX.

alex_platform: Add: please include the path and query (URL) of the failing call, and the full response body (if small) or a screenshot of it. Also include whether the issue is intermittent or reproducible every request.

alex_platform: If they can, run the repro with browser devtools network throttling off and with extensions disabled. Incognito helps rule out extension interference.

morgan_support: Awesome — I'll paste this into the customer's ticket and ask for the files named with the timestamp.

deploy-bot: NOTE: If the request-id indicates a 5xx on the service side we will need the service logs. Please include the X-Request-Id so we can correlate with backend logs.

morgan_support: Thanks — I'll request HAR + console + curl and attach the ticket when they upload. If they can't export HAR, we'll accept "Copy as cURL" + screenshots.

sam_devx: lmk if they upload and I'll take the first pass on the HAR. If I need more we'll ask for a minimal repro link and reproduction steps.
